evidence_spans: GRODE- RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek, by 26.7% on GLM-5.2, and by 20.0% on MiniMax-M3
We evaluate GRODE-RTL across 30 formally validated non-local faults using three LLMs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GLM-5.2, and MiniMax-M3) alongside a controlled five-configuration ablation study.
CLM-EDA-0054.statement: GRODE-RTL improves pass@1 over source-level exploration by 16.7% on DeepSeek.

extra_quotes: Candidates are evaluated via Yosys 20-step bounded SAT equivalence checking against the golden RTL oracle.

We evaluate 30 medium- and long-distance faults (23 designs) with source distance d (anchor declaration to fault site) ranging from 50 to 782 lines (median: 104.5): 18 mid-distance (50 ≤ d ≤ 150) and 12 far-distance (d > 150).
By bounding extraction at B, GRODE-RTL targets intra-stage combinational non-locality within a single clock cycle, deferring multi-cycle temporal unrolling to future work.
